comparison.objective: Apply paint through three stencil holes versus tune and lock a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a stencil and dab a sponge versus tool insertion, setscrew manipulation, fine collar rotation, and force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: One dab through each hole and tool clearance versus two compliant cycles without bottoming, hard-stop contact, excessive rebound, overload, or drift.
comparison.reason: Shared counterholding is generic; the controlled mechanical adjustment and dynamic validation are absent.
